title: PeridotID relayer absorbed-loss breaker caps (OQ-3 proposal, ANT-582)
unit: native base units, integer strings (lamports | stroops | wei)
method: bootstrap = ~100x p99 single-tx network fee per chain; re-tune after 7 days of sustained traffic (cap = 100 x p99 single-tx absorbed, then CTO sign-off)

notes.solana: 0.001 SOL/hr; typical fee 5-10k lamports -> ~100-200x single tx
notes.stellar: 0.1 XLM/hr; base fee 100 stroops -> ~100x loaded-tx fee
notes.ethereum: 0.02 ETH/hr; ~30x typical 21k-gas mainnet tx at 30 gwei

env.global_default: PID_RELAYER_BREAKER_CAP_LAMPORTS (applies to any chain without a per-chain value; unset = 0 = breaker disabled)

env_precedence: per-chain BREAKER_CAP_<CHAIN> (canonical) > per-chain PID_RELAYER_BREAKER_CAP_LAMPORTS_<CHAIN> (fallback alias) > global PID_RELAYER_BREAKER_CAP_LAMPORTS; first set non-empty value wins, identical on mechanism and alert sides (ANT-601). Either family alone enforces; keep both identical when both are set.
